import requests, sys, uuid, time
BASE = '{TESTVDB_DB_URL}'
c = 'Meta_' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/schema', json={"class":c,"vectorIndexConfig":{"distance":"cosine","efConstruction":128,"maxConnections":64},"properties":[{"name":"title","dataType":["string"]}]})
if r.status_code not in (200, 201): print(f'setup failed: {r.status_code}'); sys.exit(0)
time.sleep(1)
for i in range(1,11):
    r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/objects', json={"class":c,"properties":{"title":"test"},"vector":[0.1*i+0.001*(i%3),0.2*i+0.001*((i+1)%3),0.3*i+0.001*((i+2)%3),0.4*i],"id":str(uuid.uuid4())})
time.sleep(1)
q = '{ Get { ' + c + '(nearVector: {vector: [0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]} limit: 10) { _additional { distance } } } }'
r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/graphql', json={"query":q})
dists = [h.get('_additional',{}).get('distance') for h in r.json().get('data',{}).get('Get',{}).get(c,[])]
if not dists: print('no results'); sys.exit(0)
if any(dists[i] < dists[i+1] for i in range(len(dists)-1)): print(f'[DEFECT: METAMORPHIC_VIOLATION] COSINE not descending: dists={dists}'); sys.exit(1)
print(f'FLAT COSINE ordering verified: dists={dists}'); sys.exit(0)
